title: The Three Principles — Goodness, Wisdom, and Power — at Three Discrete Degrees
arc: The teaching takes three qualities men boast of in the world — Eudaimonia (blessedness/good), Sophia (wisdom), and Power (might) — and shows them as one triad which exists first in the Father, then in the aeons of the cosmos, then in the elements, descending through three discrete degrees while remaining the same three principles.
reading:
This chapter is built on a single architectural insight: there is one triad of foundational principles — Goodness (Eudaimonia), Wisdom (Sophia), and Power — and this triad repeats itself at every discrete degree of being. What men in the world point to and boast of as their well-being, their wisdom, and their strength are only the lowest reflections of a structure that begins in the inmost Divine and descends, unaltered in pattern, all the way down to the elements of the natural creation.

The teaching opens by naming these three as something the world refers to and something men glory in. That is the natural surface. The body of the chapter then says: behind that surface, the same three principles are paired with another, higher Eudaimonia, another Sophia, another Power. This pairing language ("paired-with another Eudaimonia… stands beside another Power") is the hinge: the worldly triad is not refuted, it is correspondentially anchored. What men boast of corresponds to something true above them, and that higher correspondent corresponds to something truer still.

The first and inmost register is the Father himself. Here the Eudaimonia "of glory" simply IS the Father, the God established in the great Land of Light: divine Goodness as the Divine Esse, not a quality possessed by someone but the Father as such. Sophia at this level is named as the Great One of the Spirit which runs downward through all the aeons — Divine Wisdom in her bringing-forth, the maternal pole, what the lexicon calls the Mother of Life. And the great Might at this level belongs to the rich gods and angels who were summoned forth out from him — the emanated host through which the Father's power is distributed and active. So at the inmost: Father = Goodness, Mother of Life = Wisdom, the emanated heavenly host = Power.

The second register is the cosmos of aeons — the great middle world where Divine Truth has gone forth as Sun, as Living Fire, and where the Third Ambassador stands as "the second of the Greatness." Here the Eudaimonia which is glory is the Spirit, and the Sophia is named as the mother of the Living [Soul] — that is, divine Wisdom in her receptive and generative aspect within the aeon-structure, where the Living Soul is being borne. The Power at this register is "of the gods, the rich and the angels which are within the cosmos" — those firmly established as the operative forces of this middle plane. The same triad, but now incarnated in the Sun, the Living Fire, the Ambassador, the Spirit, and the cosmic angelic order.

The third register is "in the elements" — the lowest plane, where divine reality reaches into the substance of the natural creation. Here the Eudaimonia is the Perfect Man (ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲉⲧⲭⲏⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ) — Goodness in ultimates as the column of accumulated truth that has gathered into perfected human form (the Pillar of Glory in its consummated meaning). The Sophia at this register is the Living Spirit — Divine Wisdom now operative as the structuring power that builds order in the natural. And the Power at this register is the Five Sons of the First Man — the five-fold complete Living Soul dispersed through the All, holding it up "under the All." Power, at the lowest level, is no longer a host of angels in heaven but the five attributes of Divine Truth bearing the cosmos itself.

The whole teaching is thus a vertical reading of one triad through the three discrete degrees. Goodness moves: Father → Spirit of glory → Perfect Man. Wisdom moves: Mother of Life running through all aeons → mother of the Living Soul → Living Spirit shaping the elements. Power moves: the emanated rich gods/angels of the Greatness → the angelic host within the cosmos → the Five Sons sustaining the All. At every step, the higher pours into the lower without losing identity; what looks like three different doctrines is really one Divine essence (Good, Truth, Use, in Swedenborg's familiar register) appearing under the conditions of each plane.

The implicit pastoral edge of the teaching is that what men in the world call their good fortune, their wisdom, and their power is a real but bottom-level reflection. Read upward, those same words name the Father, the Mother of Life, the Ambassador, the Living Spirit, the Five Sons. Read downward, the divine triad is what is actually at work even in the elemental ground beneath ordinary human boasting. To see the cosmos correctly is to see one Goodness, one Wisdom, and one Power threaded through three planes — and to know that the lowest is held in being by the Five Sons whose source is the Father in the Land of Light.

major_images.meaning: Divine Good descending: the Father himself → the Spirit of glory in the aeons → the Perfect Man (Pillar of Glory) in the elements
Divine Wisdom descending: the Great One of the Spirit (Mother of Life) running through all aeons → the mother of the Living Soul in the cosmos → the Living Spirit operative in the elements
Divine Power descending: the rich gods and angels emanated from the Father → the angelic host within the cosmos → the Five Sons of the First Man bearing up the All
